mapper.insert: insert into p_privilege(p_id, name, resource, domain, description, m_id) values (#{pId}, #{name}, #{resource}, #{domain}, #{description}, #{mId})
mapper.update:

t.status_cd = #{statusCd},
t.name= #{name},
t.resource= #{resource},
t.domain= #{domain},
t.description= #{description}
where t.p_id= #{pId}
